name: Dumbbell Good Morning
how_to:
1. Hold a dumbbell horizontally across your upper back, not on the neck, gripping each end with both hands.
2. Stand tall with feet hip-width apart, knees slightly bent, and core engaged.
3. Hinge at the hips, pushing your hips back while keeping your spine neutral and chest up.
4. Lower your torso until it’s nearly parallel to the floor or you feel a deep stretch in your hamstrings.
5. Drive your hips forward to return to the starting position, squeezing your glutes at the top.
6. Repeat for the desired number of reps, maintaining control and posture throughout.
